question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Visious** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**vicious**". • **Vicious **means showing a disposition to do evil, morally reprehensible, or cruel. (बुरा, नैतिक रूप से निंदनीय या क्रूर कार्य करने का स्वभाव दिखाना) • **Example**: *The dog's vicious behaviour, growling and lunging at strangers, raised concerns about its aggression.* • The incorrect spelling has "**s**" in the place of "**c**" • The correct spelling of a word is important for effective communication. Therefore, the correct answer is** option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Hoarse **is spelt correctly and means having a rough or harsh voice. (कर्कश आवाज होना) • **Imprint **is spelt correctly and means a mark or impression made by pressing something onto a surface. (किसी सतह पर किसी चीज़ को दबाने से बना निशान या छाप) • **Precious **is spelt correctly and means something of great value or importance. (बहुत मूल्यवान या महत्व की कोई चीज़) 33:Tbbf, The correct answer is: **Shuttle**.
